tasks.title: Verify build and full test suite
tasks.description:
Run `bun test` and `bun run build` to verify everything compiles and all tests pass. Fix any remaining issues.

Verification checklist:
1. `bun test` — all tests pass
2. `bun run build` — compiles without errors
3. No references to deleted functions remain in source: `buildPlanningPrompt`, `buildSummarizePrompt`, `buildPostTaskReviewPrompt`, `buildContext`, `buildClaudeMdPruning`, `PlanningPromptInput`, `SummarizePromptOpts`
4. The `agents/` directory at ralph's project root contains: `post-task-reviewer.md`, `planner.md`, `summarizer.md`
5. Grep the codebase for any remaining `--append-system-prompt` usage that should have been converted (note: plan.ts still uses it for the short dynamic context — that's expected)
tasks.notes: All 584 tests pass, build compiles cleanly. No stale references to deleted functions (buildPlanningPrompt, buildSummarizePrompt, buildPostTaskReviewPrompt, buildContext, buildClaudeMdPruning, PlanningPromptInput, SummarizePromptOpts) in src/ or test/. agents/ directory contains all 3 expected files. --append-system-prompt usage in run.ts and plan.ts is intentional and expected.
